scope: Independent source and fixture review only; no QEMU execution, native launch or build

merge_check.method: git merge-file -p ours.c base.c theirs.c; in-memory stdout comparison against merged.c

findings: The merged core only adds the default branch's explicit granule profile, walk geometry, IDR2 reporting, profile validation and VMState version 3 changes to the reviewed ours core. The blocker and debug-translation APIs and implementations are retained.

With default granule mask 1, existing 4 KiB geometry and previous unsupported-granule failure tests remain applicable. The newly accepted 16/64 KiB profiles require explicit configuration; no previous native record is reclassified as proof for them.

TG0/TG1 decoding, table stride and first-level alignment, table pointer mask and permitted block levels are internally consistent for the advertised 4/16/64 KiB subset. Read-only source review does not substitute for the separate granule gate.

The normal DMA path still checks the companion's atomic blocked mask before SID matching and translation; denied halted traffic does not create a walk fault. The debug path bypasses only that external halt filter and shares the SID match and page walker.
Companion ECATS reconstructs the byte PA using the returned addr_mask, then applies its documented 36-bit packing limit. It has no hard-coded 4 KiB mask that would truncate new granule offsets.
The real QTest client cache uses the returned IOMMUTLBEntry's mask and real IOMMU UNMAP notifier. The core invalidation and companion restore paths remain intact.

Core version 3 places the granule profile equality marker before mutable register arrays. Loading version 2 is explicitly allowed only with profile mask 1. The separate companion version remains 1 with 744-byte payload and its existing immutable reference geometry markers.

Core post_load re-drives fault IRQs and invalidates clients; companion pre_load stops its timer and closes DMA gating, then post_load validates restored state, publishes the blocker and schedules original deadlines without executing a translation. No added code introduces a first-MMIO repair dependency.

The revised companion fixture reads the two actual arm-smmuv2 migration section headers, version 3, geometries (0x100000,96,128)/(0x10000,8,128) and profile mask 1. Companion payload comparisons remain against all 744 bytes from the stopped source QOM snapshot.

The fixture still reports 36 checks, two completed migrations, two profile rejections and two corrupt-state rejections. Those counts are expected contract, not claimed execution results from this review.
required_integration_preservation: Keep the ours 1917-byte public header containing companion APIs, rather than the default branch's 778-byte header.
Retain both the old companion transaction gate and the new granule gate in the unified CI; no additional broad test expansion is requested.
